newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo Aero lifts stake in AGES to 51 percent.
newsitem.headline: Volvo Aero lifts stake in AGES to 51 percent.

text.p: Volvo Aero said Thursday it was increasing its stake in U.S. aircraft engine company AGES to 51 percent from 25 percent, at a cost of $43 million.

AGES, a Boca Raton, Fla., company that specialises in aircraft engines and engine parts but also trades and leases other aircraft materials, is expected to post revenues of $225 million for 1996 and an operating profit of $28 million.

"AGES has large significance for operations within the (civil maintenance) division, which accounted for 28 percent of turnover for Volvo Aero in 1996," Volvo Aero managing director Arne Wittlov said in a statement.
